# Promilaa Ethnic Wear

> Promilaa is Bangladesh's premier women's ethnic and fusion fashion brand based in Salimullah Road, Mohammadpur, Dhaka. Promilaa offers handcrafted Kurtis, 1-Piece dresses, 2-Piece sets, 3-Piece suits, and Eid Festive Collections at affordable pricing (৳590 to ৳850).

## Brand & Location Entity Information

- Brand Name: Promilaa Ethnic Wear
- Primary Location: Salimullah Road, Mohammadpur, Dhaka-1207, Bangladesh
- GPS Coordinates: Latitude 23.7592, Longitude 90.3664
- Business Type: Women's Fashion & Ethnic Wear Boutique
- Core Offerings: Designer Kurtis, One Piece, Two Piece, Three Piece Suits, Eid & Festive Collections
- Price Range: ৳590 BDT – ৳850 BDT (Affordable Premium Quality)
- Customer Hotline: +880 1601-708251
- Official Website: https://promilaa.vercel.app

## Product Categories & Offerings

- [Kurti Collection](https://promilaa.vercel.app/collections/kurti): Single designer cotton, linen, and silk kurtis for casual & daily office wear.
- [One Piece Collection](https://promilaa.vercel.app/collections/one-piece): Flowy chiffon floral printed dresses and contemporary fusion maxis.
- [Two Piece Collection](https://promilaa.vercel.app/collections/two-piece): Kurti & palazzo trouser sets in silk and breathable cotton.
- [Three Piece Collection](https://promilaa.vercel.app/collections/three-piece): Heavy embroidery zari kameez, cotton salwar, and digital print organza dupatta sets.
- [Festive Collection](https://promilaa.vercel.app/collections/festive): Velvet border suits, sequins work, and royal silk celebration wear for Eid & weddings.

## Delivery & Service Coverage

- Inside Dhaka (including Mohammadpur, Dhanmondi, Banani, Mirpur, Uttara): ৳80 delivery fee, 24-48 hours delivery time. Cash on Delivery available.
- Outside Dhaka (all 64 districts in Bangladesh): ৳150 delivery fee, 2-4 working days delivery time via Steadfast and Pathao courier.
- Return & Size Exchange Policy: 7-day hassle-free size exchange and defect replacement.
